PoK votes in second phase amid unrest and heavy security

Voting for the second phase in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK) occurred amidst unrest and heavy security presence. Reports described burnt-out vehicles and roads strewn with stones. The coverage highlighted the security measures in place during the electoral process.
